title: Acrylate copolymer microspheres
abstract: Infusible, solvent-dispersible, solvent-insoluble, inherently tacky, elastomeric copolymer microspheres consisting of approximately 90-99.5% alkyl acrylate ester and 0.5-10% water-soluble ionic monomers or maleic anhydride. Prepared via aqueous suspension polymerization using anionic emulsifiers above critical micelle concentration.
gist: The adhesive behind Post-it Notes: tiny sticky rubbery acrylate spheres that touch a surface only at points, so they hold paper firmly yet peel off cleanly and can be restuck again and again.
